permissions.name: beforeInitialize
permissions.description: Runs before a pool is initialized.

permissions.name: beforeSwap
permissions.description: Runs before a swap and may set a dynamic LP fee when the pool permits it.

permissions.name: beforeSwapReturnDelta
permissions.description: May change swap accounting through a before-swap delta.

permissions.name: afterSwapReturnDelta
permissions.description: May change accounting through an after-swap delta.

permissions.name: afterAddLiquidityReturnDelta
permissions.description: May return an accounting delta after adding liquidity.

permissions.name: afterRemoveLiquidityReturnDelta
permissions.description: May return an accounting delta after removing liquidity.

limitations: Unrecognized proxy patterns can remain undetected.

findings.title: Return-delta accounting enabled
findings.explanation: The address enables callbacks that can return accounting deltas. This is a protocol capability.
findings.investigation: Review callback code and compare controlled balance changes.
limitations: An indicator or capability is not a confirmed vulnerability.

findings.title: Invalid permission dependencies
findings.explanation: A return-delta flag lacks its required callback flag. The official PoolManager rejects this combination.
findings.investigation: Confirm the address and pool fee configuration.
limitations: An indicator or capability is not a confirmed vulnerability.

findings.title: Verified source unavailable
findings.explanation: Source verification could not be established. Bytecode alone does not reveal every behavior.
findings.investigation: Provide verified source and reproducible compiler settings.
limitations: An indicator or capability is not a confirmed vulnerability.

findings.title: Implementation indirection detected
findings.explanation: The observed contract may delegate behavior to a separately deployed implementation.
findings.investigation: Inspect upgrade authority and compare implementation hashes across scans.
limitations: An indicator or capability is not a confirmed vulnerability.

findings.title: External-call instructions present
findings.explanation: Executable instruction scanning found CALL-family opcodes outside PUSH data. Reachability is not proven.
findings.investigation: Use traces to identify actual targets and reachable paths.
limitations: An indicator or capability is not a confirmed vulnerability.
Unrecognized proxy patterns can remain undetected.

limitations: A getter is not proof of access control.

limitations: Sourcify verification is not a safety judgment.
